t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said : The world will bend towards us after having been refractory as the biting female camel bends towards its young. Then Amir al-Mu'minin recited the verse; "And intend We to bestow (our) favour upon those who were considered weak in the land, and to make them the Imams (guides in faith), and to make them the heirs," (Qur'an, 28:5)
